description: Hey there, little farmers in the making! Welcome to "Children Happy Farm DuDu"! This is an amazing casual simulator designed just for your kids. In this fun-filled farm world, you'll be the boss of your farm. The farm is full of cute animals like fluffy sheep, clucking chickens, and friendly cows. Your job is to take good care of them. Feed the animals, clean their shelters, and make sure they are happy.

title: The Hardest Puzzle Ever
description:
An Exciting Puzzle Game for the Whole Family! ?

Play together and train your brain every day! ?? Enjoy thrilling puzzles suitable even for the youngest players. With new levels added daily, there's always a fresh challenge waiting for you!

Have fun, improve your skills, and become a true puzzle master! ??

title: Mahjong Four Rivers
description: Discover the engaging world of Mahjong Four Rivers – a fresh take on the classic puzzle game. With its traditional charm and modern gameplay, it’s perfect for sharpening your observation and strategy skills. Enjoy beautifully designed tiles and the rewarding challenge of clearing the board. Play for free on your phone or computer, wherever you are.

title: Tile Adventure
description: A fun and satisfying tile-matching puzzle game! Match tiles in sets of three, clear the board, and enjoy a relaxing, brain-teasing experience. With smooth gameplay, colorful visuals, and levels that gradually increase in challenge, it’s perfect for anyone who loves casual puzzles. (Inspired by the classic Mahjong layout, but with a fresh, modern twist!)

title: Hangman Saga
description: Challenge your vocabulary with Hangman Saga! With thousands of levels, each word includes a category hint to guide you—like "Profession" for "Doctor." Guess the letters wisely, but too many mistakes end the game! Need help? Use the hint button for a clue. Perfect for all ages, this fun and educational word puzzle will keep you entertained while sharpening your spelling skills. Can you solve them all?

title: Word Mine
description: Word Mine takes you on a thrilling journey where letters are your treasure! Dive into a world of scrambled chaos and uncover hidden words buried in the grid. With every move, you’ll strike gold, revealing secrets that push you closer to victory. Sharpen your mind, follow the clues, and let the adventure unfold—one word at a time!

title: Plants Vs Zombies War
description: Plants Vs Zombies War is based on the famous PC game called Plants VS Zombies. This tower-defense strategy game needs your plans to fight against 15 kinds of incoming zombies. You can check the consumption and attack of all of your 15 plants before the battle. Then the tutorial will show the basic rules and plants at Level 1. The more levels you complete, the more plants you can unlock. You could also unlock them from ads in advance.

title: Pogo Masters
description: Bounce into action in Pogo Masters! Race against rivals in chaotic, physics-based platform battles where balance is everything. Compete online against players worldwide or challenge a friend locally on the same PC. Unlock dozens of unique characters, stylish pogo sticks, and eye-catching trail effects as you climb the global leaderboard. Fast-paced, competitive, and endlessly fun — become the ultimate pogo champion!

title: Christmas Merge
description:
The winter season has returned, and the North Pole is bustling with excitement! Get ready for festive fun with Christmas Merge!

The elves are in a frenzy, scrambling to match presents in time—merge them quickly before the frost sets in!

How many Santas can you create in one go? Play now, and let's find out!

title: Cat Escape
description: Play Cat Escape, the viral cat puzzle hide-and-seek game now free online! Sneak past guards, dodge traps, and guide your kitty to safety across hundreds of stealth levels. Unlock skins, collect coins, and outsmart enemies in this browser cat game loved worldwide. Want the full mobile experience? Discover more at CatEscapeTheGame.com

title: Maze Escape Challenge
description: Maze Escape Challenge is a fast-paced maze game where you must reach the exit as quickly as possible. Each level features a unique labyrinth with increasing difficulty, traps, and surprises. Some levels include Dark Mode, where you can see only a small light around the player. Earn stars by finishing mazes fast (1–3 stars), unlock new levels, beat your best times, and try to master every maze.

title: Drawing Squares
description:
Drawing Squares is the logic game that will blow your mind!
It is a logic game inspired by the classic pen and paper game Dots and Boxes. Do you remember the game you used to play at school? (also known as Boxes, Squares, Paddocks, Pigs in a Pen, Square-it, Dots and Dashes, Dots, Smart Dots, Dot Boxing, or, simply, the Dot Game).

title: Merge Hero - Survival Tower Defense
description:
Quickly merge heroes to defend against monster attacks in intense tower defense battles.
Merge Heroes is a strategy tower defense game. Form and upgrade your hero units to prepare for an epic conflict battle that will test your wisdom and abilities.

title: Stunt Fury
description: Stunt Fury takes adrenaline-fueled stunts to new heights in this action-packed gaming experience. Strap in and prepare to defy gravity as you showcase your skills on a variety of daring platforms. With heart-pounding excitement around every corner, this game challenges players to push the limits of physics and creativity.

title: Max Speed
description: Race shiny sports cars on thrilling 3D tracks full of jumps, stunts, and intense battles. Explore exciting locations with unique challenges, perform daring tricks, upgrade and customize your cars, and test your skills in fast-paced arcade races. Enjoy high-speed action, stunning visuals, and nonstop adrenaline right in your browser.

title: City Gas Station Simulator
description: Ever dreamed of running a bustling gas station? City Gas Station Simulator lets you experience the thrill of managing every detail of your very own station in a fun 3D casual simulator! From fueling cars to running a mini shop, every choice is yours to make. Fun and addictive casual management gameplay. Mix shopping and service for maximum efficiency.

title: Ninja Survivor
description: Become a nimble ninja and embark on a dangerous adventure through many levels filled with traps, enemies, and puzzles. Explore colorful 3D locations, avoid deadly mechanisms, and fight zombies and powerful bosses using speed, reflexes, and strategy. Each level requires focus and skill. Upgrade your character, unlock new weapons, and collect stylish skins to grow stronger and overcome increasingly difficult challenges.

title: Family Tree Puzzle
description:
Get ready to dig into the family history and piece together the puzzle! In Family Tree Puzzle, you’ll be presented with a set of clues that will challenge your problem-solving skills and test your ability to think critically.

Using the given information, assemble the family tree by connecting the dots between relatives and ancestors.

title: Lumber Factory Simulator
description:
Welcome to "Lumber Mill Simulator"! This is an exciting game where you own a sawmill.
Your success depends on your ability to make informed decisions, effectively manage resources and grow your business. Are you ready to become a great lumber tycoon?

title: Draw One Part Brain Puzzle
description: Ready to test your creativity and logic? Draw One Part: Brain Puzzle is a fun and clever brain teaser puzzle game that combines thinking with drawing. Each level shows an incomplete picture, and your task is to draw the missing part to solve the puzzle.

title: Doge Rush Draw Home Puzzle
description: Welcome to Doge Rush: Draw Home Puzzle! It's full of lovely adventures. There are two ways to play this game. In the Animal family party, you should help the dog and cat find their food and guide them home, drawing a line between the dog and cat's correct food. And avoid them bumping into each other. If they hit, they will get dizzy and the game will fail.

title: Labubu Jetpack Rush
description: Fly high in Jetpack Jump with Labubu to survive the escape from the lab! Tap to use the jetpack and release to run . Upgrade your jetpack, your running speed and other upgrades to be able to travel further than before and beat your high score. The further you travel the more money you get!

title: DTA 2: Maniac
description: DTA 2: Maniac. Create chaos like GTA. Use a vast arsenal of weapons, steal bulldozers, buses, police cars, tanks and much more - destruction is all around!

title: Real Racing 3D
description: Immerse yourself in exciting racing! Play classic cars - step on the gas and win! Win championships and unlock new cars!

title: Sprunki PopIt
description: Sprunki PopIt: The Ultimate Bubble-Popping Adventure! Get ready for hours of bubbly fun with Sprunki PopIt, the free-to-play online game that kids everywhere are going crazy for! It’s fast, colorful, and packed with exciting challenges. Your goal? Pop all the bubbles, dodge obstacles, and conquer level after level of pure popping chaos!

title: 99 Balls
description: 99 Balls 3D is an endless arcade game that mixes brick breaker and bubble shooter action in full 3D. Launch balls to smash numbered cylinders before they reach the bottom. Collect stars to unlock fun ball skins like sports balls, gems, or fruit. Simple to play, endlessly challenging, and highly addictive!

title: Boom Stick Bazooka
description:
In Boom Stick Bazooka, an explosive online game where you may customize your bazooka and smash platforms and opposing stickmen, you're in for a wild ride. The black stickmen are stationed in towers, and if you pause for even a second, they'll open fire, attempting to wipe off your three lives.

In each level, you'll have three chances to aim and fire; you may always try again or purchase more ammo. If you want to kill foes quickly, blow up the barrels so they explode and knock down the towers.

title: Candy Color Sort Puzzle
description: Welcome to our addictive and fun ball sort color puzzle game! If you're looking for a game that challenges your brain and keeps you entertained for hours, you've come to the right place. You'll never get bored. Our game is perfect for those who enjoy brain teasers, puzzles, and games that challenge their cognitive skills.

title: Guns vs Magic
description: Step into the shoes of Silvius, a courageous student of magic, as you fight to save the world from the dark powers unleashed by your former mentor, Lucius. Once a wise and benevolent wizard, Lucius has succumbed to the sinister influence of a cursed crystal, turning him into an evil sorcerer intent on dominating the world. Now, it's up to you to confront Lucius and his army of enchanted creatures in a battle of wits, power, and courage.

title: Pipe Puzzle: Connect & Flow
description:
Pipe Puzzle: Connect & Flow – Relaxing Brain Teaser
Connect the pipes, let the water flow, and solve hundreds of satisfying puzzles!
Pipe Puzzle: Connect & Flow is a relaxing and addictive puzzle game where your mission is simple: fix the pipes and restore the flow of water. Perfect for all ages, it's the ultimate brain exercise you can play anytime, anywhere.

title: Fidget Trading Card Toy
description: Fidget Trading Card Toy is a fidget trading game that allows you to feel the fun of collecting toy cards! In the game, you will flip cards against opponents and even use the slap feature to set off a fierce trading duel! Your goal is to collect as many rare cards as possible, increase your card collection, and gain more advantages in trading!

title: Mobile Legends Slime 3v3
description: Mobile Legends Slime 3v3 will bring you into a fun arena of exciting battles! In this 3v3 PvP game, you can unblock many slime characters. Enter a variety of colorful battle scenes. Each character has unique skills and fighting styles, ensuring you find the best gameplay.

title: Bomb Evolution
description: Bomb Evolution is a cannon-shooting arcade game. On the mysterious and mist-shrouded island, you have the opportunity to strategically establish not one, but three main bases, bolstered by an additional rocket. Engage in an enthralling battle against a formidable opponent, both of you operating under identical circumstances. Your ultimate objective: obliterating all the enemy's main bases positioned on the neighboring fog-laden island. May victory in this war be your prized accomplishment!

title: sokoban puzzle game
description: Push the Box game is an addictive and challenging puzzle game. It will help you train your brain. The operation of the game is very simple, move the box pusher by using the four direction buttons: up, down, left and right, push all the boxes to the specified position, the game is considered successful. If you are a fan of matching puzzle games, you will love our game. Keep your brain sharp while relaxing, having fun and relieving stress. Come and enjoy playing this puzzle game!

title: Table Tennis Open
description: Discover a casual, easy-to-play game for hours of endless fun. Face off against your opponent, bounce the ball as its speed increases, and aim for the highest score. Earn coins with each hit to upgrade your racket!

title: Sword Run 3D
description: Sword Run 3D is an easy to pick up action runner game. Collect sword pieces, cut off the obstacles that block your progress, and finally reach the finish line to win. More cool skins are waiting for you to unlock, what are you waiting for? Don't forget to share it with your friends if it's fun!

title: Dogs vs Aliens
description: Your favorite pets have been kidnapped by evil aliens! Hurry to save them and punish the alien bullies. Evolve to defeat stronger enemies, free new dogs, get unique resources so that your dogs can evolve! Collect all the dog breeds and see how cool they will be! Discover new territories, visit the beach, park, city square and forest!

title: Vex X3M
description:
VEX X3M, a new extreme hill racing game with bike stunts and obstacles, is here! 
Enjoy the classic Vex elements, but this time you will be racing your way to the finish line! 

Perform crazy bike stunts in 30 unique levels filled with danger - from spikes and shooting knives to rockets and lasers. Reach the finish safely and obtain stars to unlock new unique bike skins.

Complete all levels in easy and hard mode to crown yourself a master VEX X3M Rider.

Start your engines and enjoy VEX X3M!

title: Avoid The Spikes
description: Jump and dodge all the spikes to avoid dying, get score for each touch of the wall and get gems while jumping to then be able to buy new skins in the in-game store in which there are 22 to unlock in exchange for the gems obtained.

title: Pops Quest
description: In this story-based platformer, you'll step into the shoes of a heroic protagonist driven by an undying love for their child. Experience the perfect fusion of action and platforming as Pop's Quest takes you on a high-octane adventure. With its fast-paced gameplay levels designed, you'll be engrossed in a world that demands agility, strategy, and quick reflexes. As you progress, you'll be emotionally invested and driven to save your child from danger.

title: Slinky Color Sort
description: Slinky Color Sort Puzzle is a relaxing color-therapy game where you sort bright slinky rings into matching stacks. Easy to play yet surprisingly challenging, it’s perfect for calming down while keeping your brain active. Enjoy smooth gameplay, colorful levels, and satisfying logic puzzles.

title: PopCats: Merge the cats!
description: An incredibly cute game full of purring and cats. You have to connect identical cats to get bigger and bigger fuzzies. Each of them has its own story! Get to know them and connect the two biggest ones to win! Earn points and become the best cat on the leaderboard!

title: Pixel Journey
description: The “Pixel Journey” will appeal to all fans of exploration, collecting resources in a cozy pixel world. It combines a cozy atmosphere and addictive gameplay. Reach the end and find out all the secrets! Support us by leaving a review and comment! If you have any comments or suggestions, please describe them and we will try to make improvements quickly!

title: Zombie Rush
description:
Zombies Rush is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter that pits a lone survivor against an endless, evolving horde. Built for fluid action, this 2D arcade shooter, turns every escape into a high-stakes dance with death.
Tilt and weave through trees to outmaneuver the rush.
Each wave brings faster, smarter, and deadlier undead threats.
Experience a modern take on the classic zombie survival genre with clean, stylized graphics and kinetic combat.

title: Fruit Connect 3
description: Get ready for a tropical twist in Fruit Connect 3 – the juicy sequel to the popular fruit-matching puzzle series! This vibrant new chapter brings even more summer vibes, exotic fruits, and relaxing gameplay that fans love. Collect daily rewards, participate in limited-time summer events, and unlock fresh, fruity designs along the way. It’s a fun, family-friendly Mahjong-style connect game for all ages – no download required!

title: Around Elbrus
description: In the game “Around Elbrus”, the player controls a character who rushes down Mount Elbrus. The goal of the game is to collect all the coins and overcome various obstacles such as rocks, cliffs and avalanches. The game features beautiful graphics and addictive gameplay and is suitable for players of all ages.

title: Imposter 3D
description: Brace yourself for a thrilling challenge! Tap the screen to release balls and guide them into the holes each round. Afterward, head to the store to snag upgrades and cool items to power up your game. Complete levels, gather diamonds, and unlock permanent upgrades to boost your progress. How far can you take your skills? The further you go, the greater the rewards!

title: Sword And Spin
description: In Sword and Spin, you’re a brave warrior with a sword, racing through challenging arcade levels filled with obstacles and enemies. Use your sword to cut through everything in your path! Spin around with your greatsword.

title: Northern Lights - the secret of the forest
description:
A new hit for fans of the Match 3 game genre!

The Scientist Cat is already hiding items throughout the mysterious forest so you can enjoy finding things and earn as many emeralds as possible. The cat is happy to have new guests!

title: Emilys Hotel Solitaire
description: What are you going to do when you go on a journey to a tropical island? Will you spend your time in a lounger, enjoying the hot sun and cold drinks, or become a master surfer? Our heroine Emily has arrived at this heavenly place to make her honorable grandfather Douglas Kirby’s dream to build a hotel of his own come true.

title: ASMR Tattoo Treatment
description: Treat a cool rocker in your ASMR clinic! Heal their sore piercing with gentle tools, retouch their fading star tattoo, and enjoy relaxing sounds with every step. Make them smile with your careful care and earn rewards for a perfect treatment!

title: Obby Champions
description: A journey awaits you where every wall is a challenge, every obstacle is an ancient seal, and every punch is a step towards legend. Explore unique zones, fight titans, and find rare pets with unique abilities. Enter hidden codes, collect fragments of history, and leave your mark in the Hall of Echoes - only the strongest will be able to break all the seals and become the Fist of Legends!

title: Evermatch
description:
Welcome to Evermatch puzzle game! Swipe colors, solve match-3 puzzles and play.
Victories in three-in-a-row allow you to unlock new locations and landmarks. Collect and check out the most beautiful countries of the world in one game!

title: Horse Champs
description: Raise, train, and compete with your champion horse to secure first place in this thrilling horse racing simulation game. Strategize and master the art of competition.

title: Fashionista Avatar Studio Dress Up
description: It is a fun, creative dress-up and hairstyling game for all ages. Players mix and match outfits, hairstyles, and accessories to create stylish looks. The game features cute characters, diverse clothing options, and a salon scene for designing unique hairstyles, colors, and headpieces. Enjoy endless fashion fun and creativity in a joyful, relaxed atmosphere.

title: Mojicon Love Connect
description: 2Million Games presents Mojicon Love Connect: the biggest Mojicon game to date! Match sweets, beat challenging levels and discover sweet moments in the animal kingdom!

title: Bubble Race Party
description:
Cute characters race on the platform to collect water drops and fill the pools. To use the aquapark slides you need to fill the mini pools. Collect water drops and try to knock down the opponents. To get better, you can use bombs, booster boxes and doors that give positive bonuses. Try to finish first in this fun race!

Game Features:
- Colorful and fun map designs
- 1 and 2 Player game modes
- Different hats available for characters
- Surprise bonuses and game mechanics

title: Fruit Match
description:
A fresh twist on fruit puzzles!
Tap two identical fruits to detach them and send them falling into the basket.

But it’s not that simple — fruits follow real physics. They can get stuck, stack, and only fall further when you clear what’s below.
Use gravity to your advantage, trigger chain reactions, and watch satisfying cascades unfold.

Clear the board and keep the flow going as new fruits drop in!

title: Stack Battle.io
description:
It is a fun and casual puzzle. In the game, the game screen is fresh and simple, and the cute cartoon style is very eye-catching. The biggest highlight is the addition of tower defense battles to the brick-moving gameplay. The game level is very rich, and the gameplay is very simple. 
You can control the movement of the character by pressing and sliding on the screen.
What the player has to do is to control the character to collect the bricks on the map, stack the bricks and send them to your base. When there are enough bricks, your base will be upgraded and the area will be expanded and the number of tower defenses will be increased. 
When the enemy enters the range of your tower defense, you will be attacked. 
On the contrary, when you enter the range of the enemy tower defense, you will also be attacked. whichever side is attacked and dies first will fail the game, otherwise it will succeed.
Players who like brick-moving games come and download it.

title: Math Obby
description: Combine your math skills with parkour prowess in Math Obby, an engaging Roblox experience that challenges players with arithmetic problems amidst obstacle courses. Navigate through stages that test both your agility and your knowledge of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Earn badges as you progress and showcase your mastery in this educational adventure.

title: Kaboom Miner
description:
A fast-paced logical arcade inspired by classic Boulder Dash, but taken to the next level with massive chain explosions.
Your goal is simple—but dangerous: destroy all 50 explosive crates. Use falling stones, carefully placed bombs, and clever terrain manipulation to trigger devastating chain reactions. Every move matters. Push stones, move crates, build bridges from bricks, and even trap the Ghost before finishing it off.

title: Alien Hunters
description: A fast-paced game where you will play a role of a robot hunter with a deadly dagger of light. With multiple enemies to kill, and a lot of challenging missions to complete, this game will take you on a captivating and thrilling adventure.

title: Riot Village
description: Step into Riot Village, a thrilling browser-based adventure where your shooting skills and strategy are tested. Navigate 10 intense levels with AI enemies. Visit the market to choose from 6 unique weapons and equip up to 4 in your inventory. Switch weapons during gameplay to overcome challenges. The game features automatic character movement, letting you focus on aiming and shooting. Adapt your strategy as each enemy wields different weapons. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Gun Rush
description: Begin an action-packed gun battle runner. Gun Rush is an electrifying arcade game that combines gun merging with platform running. Run forward, avoid obstacles, collect weapons, and blast your way to the finish line with ultimate firepower. Control the direction of your gun, shooting power, ATK speed, and Range to increase its value. Increase your damage by using high-value doors.

title: The Earth Evolution
description: The Earth: Evolution is a relaxing placement game. What does your fantasy planet look like? You can use beautiful objects to decorate and build your unique planet in different areas of the universe. Collect sunlight by placing buildings and when you have enough sunlight, you get more resources needed to build your planet. Escape from the stressful daily life for a few minutes or even longer!

title: Clean The Floor
description:
The house is so dirty. We need a cleaner ASAP.
Your job is to clean the floor spotless and make the owner satisfied as much as possible.
Use your vacuum machine to wipe out the dirt, and trash on the floor and make them clean again

title: Obby vs Zombies
description: Obby vs Zombies is an innovative, fun-filled action game that captivated the gaming world. It challenges players to create mazes of different characters to fend off hordes of incoming zombies. The wide variety of options for attack and defense make this a highly strategic game with lots of replay value.

title: Card Master
description: Card Master is a fun and addictive puzzle game for all ages! Strategically merge identical cards to create stronger, higher-level ones while keeping the board from filling up. Use special cards and powerful boosts to clear space and score big. With its mix of strategy, challenge, and endless replay value, it’s the perfect game for anyone who loves to think ahead and have fun.

title: Chicken Strike
description: Meet the new exciting third-person shooter - Chicken Strike! Here you will act as a brave chicken who fights with opponents in different conditions. Buy a variety of skins to make your chicken unique. Enjoy jumping like a real chicken. Get ready for intense battles and become a true chicken champion!

title: Color Dodge
description:
Color Dodge is a fast-paced, addictive color-matching arcade game where reflexes and precision are your only hope!

Control a glowing circle and survive as colorful walls charge toward you from all directions. Here's the twist — you must collide only with the wall segment that matches your color, or you explode in a juicy blast!

Whether you're chasing high scores or just vibing with neon chaos, Color Dodge delivers bite-sized action with a splash of style.

title: Ninja Wars: Battle Simulator
description: Ninja Wars: Battle Simulator is a 3D strategy battle game where planning is the key to victory. Build your army of Swordsmen, Spearmen, and Archers, analyze enemy formations, and lead your ninja forces to triumph across challenging levels.

title: Knit Rescue
description:
Knit Rescue is an engaging and original puzzle game where you untangle a knitted dragon to save a frightened kitten.

But it’s not enough to simply tap the right spools. You must unlock the correct spools and move them in the right direction to stop the dragon in time.

Plan your moves, follow the arrows, and solve each level using logic and strategy. Knit Rescue is the perfect casual puzzle game for fans of brain games, logic puzzles, and strategy games.

title: Stumble Guys
description: Stumble Guys is a very hot adventure elimination game. A variety of fun levels await your challenge, and the time has come to test your memory and dexterity! Run, sprint, and slide to overtake your opponents and dodge the obstacles that keep popping up. Can you survive to the end? Invite your friends to join you and kill them all!

title: No Pain No Gain - Ragdoll Sandbox
description: A ragdoll sandbox physics game where you place traps, cause pain, and earn coins for every hit. The more it hurts, the more you get.

title: Kingdom Wars TD
description: Welcome to Kingdom Wars TD, an exciting tower-defense strategy game set in a captivating 2D kingdom. Assume the role of a skilled commander entrusted with the defense of a mighty castle. In your quest, assemble a formidable army comprising up to five soldiers, including archers, warriors, and priests. Brace yourself for the challenge of surviving two perilous waves across various meticulously designed levels scattered throughout the map. Immerse yourself in this thrilling adventure!

title: Pull the Pin: Fish Rescue!
description: Pull the Pin: Fish Rescue! is a relaxing and addictive puzzle game with lots of interesting puzzles. You will see several niches in it. They will be separated by partitions. In one niche you will see a fish, and in another water. You will need to carefully study everything and pull the pin. Thus, you will open it and water will get to the fish.

title: 9 Blocks
description: Logical puzzle game with original gameplay. The goal is to fill all empty places in a chip merging with chips next to this one.

title: Phone Case DIY Run
description: Phone Case DIY Run is a very fun simulation game. What type of phone case do you have now? If you are interested in making a phone case, then come and join us to learn about the process! Collect the models, choose your favorite color for painting, then paste the picture and choose the pendant. Finally, the more phone cases you collect when you reach the end, the more money you get. Have fun!

title: Labo Brick Train Game For Kids
description: This is an assembly train game for all ages. Do you like small train toys? Have you ever wanted to assemble a beloved train by yourself? You can't miss our game if you are interested in all this.First of all, you need to pick out your favorite train style. Then start assembling the train from the locomotive, followed by the body.

title: Bento Match
description:
Slide the blocks to line them up straight and clear them!
If there’s space, you can move multiple blocks at once.
You can also move blocks without clearing them, but you’ll lose 1 life.
Earn coins based on your score and use them to collect new blocks!
Collected blocks will appear randomly in the game—rare blocks give higher scores!

title: Snow Race 3d Fun Racing
description: Snow Race 3D: Fun Racing is an addictive arcade game. Do you want to participate in a snow race? This is probably the most fascinating and addictive game you have ever played! Collect the snow around you to make huge snowballs, then let them build ladders and climb to higher levels. Your opponents will have the same talent and you will have to race against time to race against them! Be the first to reach the finish line to win! Come join us and become a snowball master!

title: Hidden Pairs Mahjong
description: Match and clear all the tile in this Hidden Pairs Mahjong solitaire game. Use your observation skills to find and select identical open tiles to remove them from the board. With beautifully designed classic Mahjong symbols, smooth animations, and a calming background, each level offers a fresh puzzle challenge.Earn bonus time, increase your score, and progress through endless levels of tile-matching fun!

title: Bubble Shooter Candy Wheel Level Pack
description: Bubble Shooter Candy Wheel Level Pack is a fun and challenging game where you shoot candy bubbles to match three or more on a rotating wheel. Use power-ups like the Bomb to blast nearby candies and the Stopwatch to freeze time for unlimited moves. Earn coins by clearing levels and use them to unlock more exciting levels. With increasing difficulty and sweet rewards, this game promises endless fun. Spin, aim, and conquer the candy wheel!

title: Merge Fellas Online
description: Enjoy the Italian Brainrot meme world in this Merge game. Immerse yourself in the Italian Brainrot world and merge identical characters to accumulate points and reach the highest score. A simple and easy mechanic, drop characters together to form higher-value ones, providing rewards with each successful merge.  Solve the puzzle and merge all the pets!

title: Pocket Parking
description: Get all the cars out of the parking lot wthin the time limit! The car goes straight forward and backward. Move it in a direction where there are no walls or cars.

title: Art Puzzle Master
description:
Welcome to Art Puzzle Master, a fun and challenging puzzle game that will test your logic and problem-solving skills! 

In this game, you'll be presented with a series of beautiful artworks that have been divided into small, jumbled pieces. Your task is to rearrange the pieces and form the complete image, but be careful – the puzzles get more difficult as you progress through the levels!

title: Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem
description:
Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem is an exciting motorcycle racing game. 
In this game you will become a motorcycle racer who travels through city streets and highways, avoiding collisions with other vehicles. You will be able to unlock faster and more powerful motorcycles, each with its own unique handling characteristics, as well as improve the characteristics of your motorcycle. One of the key features of the game is a realistic physics engine that makes the gameplay challenging and exciting.

title: Grocery Shop: Supermarket Game
description: Run and manage your own supermarket in this engaging simulation game. Stock shelves, serve customers, manage inventory, and expand your store to build a successful grocery business. Handle the rush of customers while keeping products organized and priced competitively to maximize profits.

title: Wordler
description:
It's the same English word guessing game as Hackman I played when I was young.
You are given six chances to guess a word that consists of only five letters.
How many times can you get it right?

title: Digital Circus Find The Differences
description:
Step into the whimsical and wacky world of Digital Circus: Find The Differences, where fun meets challenge! Explore vibrant and surreal circus scenes filled with unique characters and zany details, all while sharpening your observation skills. Can you spot the subtle changes between two seemingly identical pictures?
Put your eyes to the test and discover how many differences you can find in this exciting puzzle adventure!

title: Obby Prison Run
description: Obby Prison Run is an intense obstacle course game where escape is the only option—and survival is everything. Sprint, leap, and dodge through deadly traps and twisted takes on classic childhood games. Outsmart your rivals and stay ahead in the race for freedom, where every second counts and only the sharpest make it out alive.

title: Twinkle Shooter
description: Shoot at stones of the same color to drop them. They can be cleared when three or more of the same color are matched. If a stone enters the heart, the slot spins for a fever chance! The game is over if the stones reach the bottom.

title: Squid Game: Playground Shooter
description:
In "Squid Game: Playground Shooter", every shot triggers a wave of chaos-take down all the Squid Game characters in the level and watch them fly around with crazy physics!

What’s waiting for you:
- Switch guns and enjoy unique effects with every shot.
- Each scene is a new challenge and a chance to create Squid Game-style chaos.
- Explosions, traps, interactive objects
– Instantly recognizable icons!

Dive into the shooting frenzy and ragdoll madness!

title: Super Racing
description: Compete to earn the most points across four connected courses with your favorite characters. The whole world is your racetrack in the Super Racing World game. Race from one course to another through interconnected paths that span the world. Traverse mountains, forests, cities, and more—with shifting weather patterns and a day/night cycle. Everything is connected! Collect coins and unlock new cars and characters.

title: Sprunki Challenge
description: Sprunki Challenge game adds a challenge mode to the famous Sprunki game and activates the game's battle mode. While the 1 Player mode of the game includes the classic mode, in the 2 Player mode you both make music using Sprunki characters and try to reach 2000 by generating scores. You can play the game with your friend in both dark mode and normal mode. If you want, you can also activate different backgrounds.

title: DON'T PANIC DUDE!
description:
Meet DUDE, a sassy AI who thinks you can't beat his game! Trapped in his chaotic simulation, your goal is simple: Jump, avoid deadly spikes, and survive to prove him wrong.

Features:

Fast-paced endless jumping action.

Unlock 40 unique and funny heroes.

Hilarious AI commentary and memes.

Increasing speed and difficulty.

Can you handle the chaos? Don't panic, just jump!

title: Hydraulic Press 2D ASMR
description: You have in your hands a terrifying power that gives you the ability to grind dozens of objects! A very effective stress reliever. Try out your personal hydraulic press right now and start destroying all objects! Crush, crush, break!

title: Merge Squares
description: "Merge Squares" is an exciting puzzle game, where your task is to connect squares with same numbers. Using logic and strategic mind, you have to decide how to arrange the squares to combine them into one. Each level gets harder, how far can you go?

title: Royal puzzle Burst
description: Tap blocks of the same color to make them burst and eliminate attacking blobs! Enjoy a straightforward and gratifying game with intuitive controls.

title: Water Shooter
description: Welcome to the 'Water Shooter'! In this exciting first-person shooter game, you will find yourself in the role of a young hero who received a water pistol as a gift. Armed with this reliable weapon, you boldly go to the dungeon, where battles with fiery monsters await you. Immerse yourself in a fascinating world of adventures, explore mysterious corners and show everyone that your water trunk has the power of victory over fire!

title: Wheel in the face
description:
Jump behind the wheel of a furious combat vehicle and rush into battle! Lightning-fast battles await you in closed arenas: ram enemies, dodge traps, use deadly weapons and win deadly fights.

Choose your style: cut your opponents with a sword, shoot them with a shotgun or burn them to the ground with a flamethrower!

Upgrade cars, weapons and wheels, earn money and raise your rank.

title: Portal Hop
description: Portal Hop is a platform puzzle game where you carry a portal above your head and use it to solve tricky challenges! Move through each level by warping yourself onto higher platforms, collecting plus and minus power-ups to adjust the height of your portal. Think smart, plan your moves, and find the perfect path to reach your destination. Ready to warp your way to victory

title: Italian Brainrot Find the Differences
description: In this game you have to locate the differences between the two pictures in the limited amount of time given to play each time! To play, use your mouse as control. Make sure that you don’t make a mistake more than three times because that will make you fail. One minute is the total time you will play through the 20 levels in this game! In each level you have seven differences. Good luck!

title: Escape Room Mystery Key
description: Escape Room Mystery Key is an intense escape room adventure filled with horror and puzzle elements. Choose a role to enter an abandoned school or a hospital. Uncover hidden clues and keys to find your way out. In this game, you must carefully examine every detail in the room, searching for hidden clues.

title: Dynamons 7
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 7! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Tall Pines world and the bonus cave.

Seasoned Dynamons connoisseur Jovani will tell you everything you need to know to become a true Dynamon Captain. Encounter Crocynos, Huango, Cybeenyx, Aragonyx and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: Color Jam 3D
description:
Color Jam 3D is a fun and relaxing match-and-merge puzzle game! Combine crayons of the same colors  to fill the picture and bring stunning images to life with vibrant colors.
With engaging gameplay and satisfying color-filling mechanics, Color Jam 3D offers a unique blend of puzzle-solving and artistic expression.

title: Valentines Hidden Alphawords
description: Valentines Hidden Alphawords is a charming and relaxing Valentine’s Day–themed puzzle game where love meets word discovery. Explore beautifully designed romantic scenes filled with hidden letters waiting to be found. Each completed level reveals a sweet and heartwarming caption that perfectly matches the image. With 30 engaging levels, increasing challenges, and a ticking clock with useful hints, the game keeps players entertained while celebrating the spirit of love.

title: EQ Test Puzzle
description: A puzzle game that tests emotional intelligence through emotion recognition and jigsaw puzzles. Match emotional icons, scenarios, and puzzle pieces to train your emotional awareness and problem-solving skills.

title: 21 Cards
description: 21 Cards is a fun and addictive blackjack-style puzzle game where your goal is to reach exactly 21 points in each column. The game combines the thrill of classic card play with a cozy, home-style atmosphere. Place cards wisely, complete columns, and aim for the perfect 21!

title: VSCO Girl Aesthetic
description: Welcome to the VSCO Girl Aesthetic. Rainbow High school girls Sunny, Skyler, Ruby, and Violet are the trendy fashion girls. They planned to try VSCO fashion which is trending all over social media. Join and browse their wardrobe to pick some suitable outfits for the girls. Play and Have fun!

title: Mine FPS shooter: Noob Arena
description: Enter dynamic arenas packed with relentless enemies, each wave more challenging than the last! Equip yourself with 7 different weapons and 5 types of armor to face off against diverse foes. With unique square graphics and three arenas to conquer, gear up for the ultimate boss battle at the end!

title: Italian Brainrot Challenge
description: Welcome to the Italian Brainrot Challenge quiz game with the characters from Strange Animals! Choose your difficulty and test your knowledge of the Brainrot characters. Tap the correct answer from multiple choices and collect points as you go through the world of Italian Brainrot.

title: 4 Hexa
description: 4 Hexa is a fun, colorful online puzzle game! Merge same-number blocks to reach higher scores in this addictive math trivia challenge. Perfect for fans of block match games and brain teasers! Play now and test your skills!

title: Block Blasty Saga
description:
Place the blocks on the board and crush them all! Complete the lines with the various block shapes and blast them all! Get ready to become the block master!

Play the game in two modes: classic way and adventure mode. Try to achieve the highest score in Classic mode by blasting the most block amount, it is an infinite game mode and increases the fun with ASMR sounds. In Adventure mode, complete the tens of chapters and improve your block-crushing skills step by step. Join the saga now!

title: Mojicon Garden JigSolitaire
description: Piece together a paradise in Mojicon Garden Jigsaw Solitaire! Solve beautiful puzzles to restore a dry meadow back to a lush, blooming garden. Enjoy a meditative experience with smooth controls and the iconic Mojicon art style. Can you bring the garden back to life?

title: Animal in Rails!
description:
An exciting puzzle game about delivering animals to a trader's base

Connect and disconnect railways around the world to help each animal reach its home.

Install, remove, and redirect connections so that wagons can safely connect to the locomotive. But be careful and don't let them collide with each other!

Delay trains by using railway barriers. Change the tracks to redirect the wagons in different directions. Pick up new pets along the way and face even more challenges along the way!

title: Panda Dash Auto Shooting
description: Jump straight into explosive action with Panda Dash Auto Shooting! In this fast-paced side-scrolling shooting adventure, you guide a fearless panda warrior into chaotic arenas packed with endless zombie waves. Each battle throws you into intense combat where survival depends on positioning and strategy. Every round feels stronger, faster, and more thrilling than the last! Get ready, grab your gear, and dash into zombie chaos!

title: Space Cleaner
description:
Space Cleaner is a casual space arcade game where you clear dangerous asteroid fields around your spacecraft. Use your mouse to destroy nearby asteroids, earn money, and survive as long as your fuel lasts.

When your fuel runs out, upgrade your ship’s abilities and return to space to continue cleaning the asteroid field. Destroy every asteroid to complete the stage and unlock the next challenge.

title: Clinic Cleanup Crew
description:
Players play the role of cleaners in the health center in the game. They are responsible for the cleaning and sanitation work in all areas within the health center, keeping the environment of the health center clean and hygienic and providing a good environment for clients.
The game features a fresh and lovely art style, with the details of characters and buildings depicted vividly, bringing players a healing visual enjoyment.

title: Ellie And Friends Get Ready For First Date
description: Join Ellie And Friends Get Ready For First Date! Explore chic ensembles, trendy accessories, and glamorous styles to make a lasting impression. Dive into the excitement of the first date as these fashion-forward friends set the trend for the perfect look. Elevate your style game, embrace the thrill of romance, and let Ellie and Friends guide you through a fashionable journey to a memorable first date. Make every moment stylish and unforgettable!

title: Aim Ninja
description:
Aim Ninja is a fast-paced skill game that tests your timing and reflexes. 
Stop the moving needle at the perfect moment to score points and improve your accuracy. 
Simple to play but hard to master, Aim Ninja delivers quick, satisfying gameplay sessions 
for players of all ages.

title: Anaconda Runner
description: Anaconda Runner is a casual arcade game. In the snake kingdom, size is a status symbol. The bigger you are, the more powerful you are and the higher your status. So how do you increase your size?  There is a runway in front of you. There are many blue balls on the runway that can help you grow. See how far you can go, have fun!

title: Save The Sheep
description: Save The Sheep offers an immersive mental challenge as you step into the shoes of a shepherd. Relentless wolves have invaded your flock, seeking to feast on your precious sheep. Safeguard your flock by strategically placing wooden stakes to separate them from the predators. Experience the electrifying thrill of rescuing sheep and demonstrate your unmatched intellect in this captivating game.

title: Car Stunt Racing 3D
description: Car Stunt Racing 3D is a fun racing game. Open this incredibly entertaining car racing mobile game and prepare yourself to engage in all kinds of thrilling races. Place your fingers on the ground and get ready for the unexpected. You will never know what you will encounter when making your next turn. Collect energy and money, evade opponents, and join us to experience the thrill of speed and excitement! We wish you a joyful gameplay experience!

title: Bull Runner
description: Take control of a powerful bull as it charges forward at full speed! Smash through obstacles, knock over stickmen, and leave destruction in your wake. How far can you go before something stops you? Test your reflexes and unleash the unstoppable force of the raging bull!

title: Pixel Shoot
description: Pixel Shoot is a fast-paced arcade puzzle game. It's simple to play by just tapping the cannons. Make sure you pay attention to the color and base your strategy around it. You must also manage your capacity, and timing is key! Send your cannons in the right order, manage the flow, and maximize your score.

title: Squid Game Hunter
description: Step into the thrilling world of Squid Game – a fast-paced game for stealthy and strategic players that takes you on a wild adventure as a hunter with a deadly knife. With multiple Squid games enemies to kill, challenging missions to complete, and rewards to collect, this game will test your skills and keep you on the edge of your seat.

title: Elevator Fight
description: Make your way to the top floor, one fight at a time. Every level, a new challenger steps in, but only one can ride up! With simple controls and over 130 levels, this game offers quick, close-quarters combat in a cramped elevator. Upgrade your fighter’s speed, power, and defense to keep up with the ever-changing, humorous opponents. What’s waiting at the top?

title: Poppy Strike 5
description: Poppy Strike 5 is a first person shooter game with elements of horror where your mission is to use big arsenal of weapons to shoot huggy wuggy and kisiy misiy and find a way to escape liminal spaces of haunted toy factory.

title: Rescue Rift
description: Embark on a heart-pounding mission in "Rescue Rift," an intense and immersive action-adventure game that challenges your tactical skills and courage. As an elite operative of an undercover rescue team, you find yourself thrust into the depths of danger as you attempt to save hostages who have been kidnapped and confined within the eerie confines of an old, abandoned hospital.

title: Steampunk Tower Builder
description: Build the tallest tower and touch the sky with the steampunk tower builder! Simply tap to release the blocks, making sure to release them at the right time to balance the tower. The tower will rise higher with each correctly placed block. If a block falls, you’ll have to start over. Use the funds you’ve accumulated to build as high as possible and climb the leaderboard!

title: Mermaids Spot The Differences
description: Dive into an enchanting underwater world with "Mermaids: Spot The Differences"! Explore vibrant ocean scenes teeming with mermaids and sea creatures as you sharpen your observation skills to uncover subtle distinctions. Immerse yourself in the magic of the deep blue and embark on an adventure of keen-eyed discovery!

title: Hexa Sort 3D
description: Hexa Sort 3D mixes puzzle challenges, strategic matching and a satisfying merging experience.Involving clever puzzle-solving and logical manoeuvres, this game is ideal for those seeking a mental workout. As the levels progress, players will find the game both addictive and calming, striking the perfect balance between challenge and relaxation. Put your skills to the test with tasks such as sorting, stacking and merging hexagonal tiles.

title: Nuts And Bolts Screw Puzzle
description:
Nuts And Bolts Screw Puzzle is a puzzle game to remove bolts from the board, by moving the bolts to other bolt holes. The game will be finished when all the boards are gone
This challenging and addictive Wooden Nuts & Bolts puzzle game will test your problem solving skills as you twist, turn and strategize your way through a maze of tricky Wooden tools. With each level, the puzzles become more complicated and complex.

title: Mr Disc: Slingshot Strike
description:
Mr Disc is here to strike! Swipe, aim, and throw powerful discs to smash enemies, break obstacles, and clear every level in style.
Easy to play, hard to master – can you become the ultimate Slingshot Striker?

title: Venetian Love Affair
description: Go to the festive Venice and become a fashion stylist for two girlfriends, each of whom dreams of an unforgettable fancy dress. Create unique masks with great designs and choose luxurious Baroque dresses, jewelry and accessories. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of mystery and romance of the Venetian carnival. Unleash your talent as a fashion designer in a unique way for the masquerade participants. Get ready for a magical journey into the world of love and mysteries!

title: Mahjong build farm
description: A cozy blend of classic Mahjong and farm simulation! Start with a small green hill and turn it into a blooming farm by matching tiles and completing levels. The mechanics are simple and relaxing — find and match three identical picture tiles to clear the board. You'll have 90 unique levels with varying difficulty, from easy puzzles to real challenges for experienced players. If you get stuck, bonuses are always there to help.

title: Parking Master Urban Challenges
description:
A realistic 3D parking simulator where you can hone your driving skills and become a real parking master!
Get behind the wheel of realistic cars of different sizes and maneuver through crowded city streets, parking in the most difficult places.
Pass all the tests, become a parking master and prove that you can do any maneuver!

title: Color Bump Dancer
description: Color Bump Dancer is a fun and casual puzzle game, with cool colors that greatly enhance the fun of the game. Various classic levels are waiting for you to pass, and there are also various gameplay options, don't miss the game!

title: Gun Racing
description: Here you cannot just race with other cars, but destroy them with the help of numerous weapons. Improve your riding skills and take first places in tournaments!

title: Siberian Assault
description: Siberian Assault is an intense first-person shooter set deep in the unforgiving Siberian wilderness, where players are dropped into a hostile winter jungle brimming with enemy forces. As an elite operative, your mission is to survive relentless waves of enemies in this icy, snow-laden environment.

title: Skyscraper to the Sky
description: Challenge your skills as an engineer and architect in this  puzzle game. Build the tallest, most stable skyscraper across 30 levels, from small houses to huge buildings.

title: Dynamons 10
description: Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 10! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Gold Temple world and the bonus cave. Encounter Tyrexar, Tyceratox, Cobragora, Pterodanox, Knightanyx and the diamond Guardian and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: Magic Kingdom. Hex Match
description: Magic Kingdom: Hex Match is a game where you are the third son of a great king, sent to a distant land to prove your worth. Collect six vital resources—food, water, stone, wood, workers, and metal—to construct new buildings. Unlock all structures and create a stunning, magical kingdom!

title: Collect Honey Puzzle
description:
Collect Honey Puzzle is a popular and favorite merge game. You are now in charge of collecting honey, but you need to slowly upgrade to collect it. You can start by collecting sticks and
upgrading to bricks. Upgrade from one brick to three and then to the honey jar and finally collect the honey successfully.  You can also challenge your highest record anytime, and anywhere. If you are interested in this game, join us!

title: Tap 3D Blocks
description: Layers upon layers of dice await your skillful touch. Some puzzles ask you to think. This one dares you to see the whole picture. Flip, rotate and reveal new tiles as you uncover unexpected paths. Boosters lend a hand, but the strategy is all yours.

title: Capybara Suika
description:
Capybara Suika is a fun and relaxing food merge puzzle game starring adorable capybaras!
Inspired by the viral Suika Game, drop and merge food to grow bigger and score higher.
With colorful visuals, cozy vibes, and a tiny game size, it’s the perfect lite game to enjoy anytime!

title: Blue VS Red
description: Sort blue and red items as fast as you can! Drag or use arrow keys to send each item to the correct zone. Build combos, beat the timer, and earn coins to buy power-ups. Challenge yourself in solo mode or compete against AI bots. How high can you score in 30 seconds?

title: Dusty Cat
description: Help the little speck of dust to grow into a real cat! Eat other dust, avoid larger enemies and grow to see all the phases of your Dusty Cat! Collect points and compete with other players to get your scores on the leaderboard!

title: Bubble Pop Legend
description:
Bubble Pop Legend is the best way to kill time.
Aim & shoot to pop all colorful bubbles to clear the board and win coins.
You'll spend hours with fun & addictive Bubble Pop Legend to keep your mind active.

▶ How to Play

• Aim carefully and tap where you want to shoot
• Match 3 or more bubbles of same color to pop them
• Pop all colorful bubbles to win levels
• Use less shots to get higher score and earn 3 stars
• Plan and use epic boosters at the right time to BLAST ALL LEVELS

title: Loop Ghost
description: Time loop puzzle: ghosts of your past cycles automatically repeat your moves. Use them to press buttons, open passages, and escape together.

title: Wild Race Master 3d
description: Wild Race Master 3D is an exciting 3D racing game that brings you into a world of extreme speed!In this game, you can experience endless racing fun and drive various cool cars. Challenge the exciting track! ? Drive your beloved racing car through various unique and challenging tracks. You should show excellent driving skills on winding roads and be flexible when dealing with various complex track conditions.

title: Word Search Universe 2
description: Word Search Universe 2 is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you find hidden words across many themed levels. Explore categories like science, history, food, nature, and more while sharpening your focus and vocabulary. Simply swipe letters to form words, complete challenges, and unlock new chapters. With clean visuals, smooth controls, and hundreds of words to discover.

title: Flip Knife
description: Explore different rooms, jump on all sorts of objects: shelves, tables, chairs, sofas, and even subwoofers!Make the knife jump or even double flip. How? Just tap the screen at the right moment and jump!

title: Feet Doctor Urgency Care
description:
As a podiatrist in this medical simulation game, treat various urgent foot conditions and save patients. As a doctor, you will take care of the patient's feet.
Use all tools to cure them.

title: Packing Line
description: Ship all the cans. Choose a box of the same color as the can. The game is over if you run out of space for boxes and the line stops.

title: Robbotto
description: Robbotto is an arcade platformer with a retro esthetic. Play alone or with a friend as you travel through the ship defeating all the enemies.

title: From Nerd to Popular Ballerina Cappuccina
description:
From Nerd to Popular: Ballerina Cappuccina is a makeover and dress-up game that follows a sweet transformation story. Ballerina Cappuccina starts as a shy, awkward girl with big dreams—and it’s your job to help her glow up and become the confident ballerina she’s meant to be.

Style her through each stage with fabulous outfits, stylish hairstyles, and elegant accessories. As you dress her up, she slowly sheds her insecurities and gains the charm and confidence needed to shine on stage.

title: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online
description: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online game takes the familiar lucky box idea and turns it into a more active risk-and-return loop. You move through 14 areas, open boxes, collect brainrots, and decide whether to head back safely or keep pushing for rarer finds. Online play is available through 1 Player mode, while local 2-player adds a same-screen option for faster, more chaotic sessions. Rebirth, speed upgrades, better boxes, base expansion, and roaming bosses keep every run moving forward.

title: LOL Funny Dance
description: LOL Funny Dance is a hilarious 2D game where you can distort the faces of politicians and celebrities to create the funniest expressions! Drag and move different points on the image to stretch, twist, and transform their looks into ridiculous and exaggerated versions. Watch them dance and react as you manipulate their faces in real time. Play the LOL Funny Dance game now.

title: Dot by Dot
description:
Dot By Dot is a relaxing puzzle game where you have to connect dots into lines and get amazing drawings. Once you connect all the dots and lines, the drawing will be automatically colored! Enjoy the addictive puzzle game!
Let the Dot by Dot game develop your creativity and skills. Draw a line, connect colored dots and see what kind of drawing you get.

title: Animal Royal
description:
"The ultimate player versus player game allows players to engage in battles against their opponents using unique animals."
You'll be challenged to use your wits and strategy to outsmart your opponents and emerge victorious.
Animal Royal is a game that features a wide variety of animals and birds, each with its unique strengths and weaknesses.
Your goal is to protect your meat from being eaten by your opponent's animals while sending your animals to eat as much meat as possible to win the battle.

title: Gym Muscle Merge Tycoon
description: Gym Muscle: Merge Tycoon is an addictive game where you create your team of fighters and transform them into real muscle heroes. Connect fighters to strengthen their muscle mass, improve their characteristics, and earn profit. Participate in fighting tournaments to compete for cool rewards and become the most powerful fighter of all time!

title: RiddleMath
description: Math Riddles level up your IQ with a mix of logical puzzles. Challenge yourself with different levels of math games and stretch the limits of your mind. Brain games are prepared with an approach of an IQ test.

title: Paint Pop 3D
description:
Paint Pop 3D is an one-tap hyper casual shooting game that will keep you hooked for hours!

Tap to paint. Hold for more fun!
Stay away from obstacles and paint all slices on the ring.

Features:
- More than 1000+ levels to experience game play.
- A lot challenging missions.
- Various characters & themes.
- Beautiful graphic.

title: Idle Farm
description:
Run your own successful farm and build an empire! The more you grow and harvest, the more money you get!
Use the money to upgrade your fields and make harvesting even more effective at producing food. Keep an eye on your production - with careful planning you’ll achieve everything! Expand your farm further and further until you truly own an empire.
Hire farm managers to do most of the work for you. Use their help to expand your farming empire, plant new crops and produce even more food!

title: Sniper Master
description: Take aim in mid-air and strike at the perfect moment! In Sniper Master, you jump, float, and fire while airborne—time your shots to eliminate targets with clean, satisfying hits. Stay calm, lead your aim, and master precision shooting across multiple levels. Earn rewards, improve your skills, and become the ultimate airborne marksman.

title: Gun Match Screw
description: a unique level-based puzzle game that combines screw puzzles with exciting gun-themed mechanics. In this game, each level presents you with a board shaped like different guns or gun parts, and your goal is to unlock all the boards by matching colored screws, which are represented as bullets.

title: Offroad Climb 4x4
description:
Welcome to "Offroad Climb 4x4", where the hills are alive with the roar of engines! This isn't just a game; it's an off-road odyssey. Imagine climbing up hills, navigating through a scrapyard of cars, scaling rocky terrains, and conquering snow-laden paths.

Whether you're a hardcore off-road enthusiast or just looking for some casual hill-climbing fun, "Offroad Climb 4x4" has something for everyone. So, buckle up, start your engines, and let the off-road adventure begin!

title: Obby The Legendary Dragon
description:
Experience the thrill of an addictive pet-catching simulator, perfect for Pokémon fans! Explore diverse Roblox worlds and level up your heroes all in one exciting adventure.
Gather health, upgrade your hero, and unlock incredible new worlds to discover. Catch pets in battles, hatch them from cases and eggs, and trade or purchase them to build a team of powerful allies and friends. Earn money, climb the ranks, and enhance your Obby character with prestigious titles and upgrades!

title: Christmas Candy Escape 3D
description: Christmas Candy Escape 3D is a casual puzzle in which you have to fall safely. It is deceptively simple, yet profoundly deep. Play through the extensive stages, sharpening your wits as you have fun. Have a try!

title: Metal Bay Top Blade Power
description:
Metal Bay Top Blade Power is a top-down action game inspired by spinning blade battles.

Control a powerful metal top blade and fight against enemies in the Metal Bay arena, using real-time physics-based collisions and spin power mechanics.

Master speed, impact force, and rotation control to understand when to attack, collide, or evade.

title: Mickey Run Adventure Game
description:
Welcome to the great kingdom craft! prepare yourself brave mickey, get ready to run, jump, dash and rush through the kingdom.
In this craft game, you will be a runner who has to run and collect coins in an endless runner game mine. You need to be very careful as there will be many mouse in your way. You will need to use your craft Mickey and reflexes to avoid them and keep running. There will also be power-ups that you can collect to help you in the craft game.

title: Zindex
description:
You are in an epidemic-stricken zone. The streets are filled with hordes of hungry zombies, and the survivors have long since abandoned this place. Your only hope for rescue is to repair an abandoned radio tower and call for help.
Explore dangerous locations, scavenge houses, crates, and closets in search of valuable resources. Gather materials to craft weapons, tools, and essential items. Fight zombies in melee combat or use firearms—the choice is yours.

title: Brainrots Lava Survive Online
description: Brainrots Lava Survive Online is an intense survival experience where rising lava transforms the map into a dangerous obstacle zone. Players must collect brainrots in risky areas and escape before the lava blocks safe routes. Online mode is available in 1 Player, allowing chat and interaction, while 2 Player mode offers local shared-screen competition. With more than 60 characters in normal, gold, diamond, Celestial, and time-limited Divine tiers, progression stays dynamic.

title: Astral Escape
description: Astral Escape is a thrilling space game where you dodge asteroids, outsmart aliens, and survive cosmic traps in a fast escape game adventure. Explore galaxies in a sci-fi arcade escape with astronaut missions and star quests. Fans of cool math games, Roblox, Minecraft, snake game, or Kahoot-style challenges will enjoy this galaxy escape quest. Astral Escape blends action, strategy, and fun into one cosmic survival run.

title: Ultrahero Vs Monsters Royale Battle
description: Ultrahero Vs Monsters Royale Battle is an action fighting game where you, as a mighty Ultrahero. Battle against waves of evil monsters in a 3D world. Every battle is a new adventure. Feel the perfect fusion of tower defense and nervous arcade action in this game. As a hero, you must not only fight off monsters in epic battles but also use tower defense tactics to protect your base.

title: Dragon Egg
description: Players can unlock higher-level Divine Dragon eggs by moving three or more of them. Supports multi-level recursive synthesis of 5-color dragon eggs. Eventually, unlocking high-level dragon eggs can unlock the birth of new dragons, accompanied by splendid animations, filling the sense of achievement to the fullest.

title: Pixel Mini Golf
description:
Mini Golf is a complete game, with 400 different levels, and an addictive system. Have fun exploring the game’s green hills and plains while listening to the birds and enjoying its beautiful views, collect as many coins as possible and try to hit all the holes to achieve the highest score.

Among the game mechanics are levels with: Portals, Boxing Gloves, Cannons, Burners, Impulses, Mill, Sand, Mole Holes, Spikes and Movement Blocks that will help or hinder your game!

title: Watermelon merge
description:
In this exciting game you will plunge into the fascinating world of combining different fruits. When they collide, they combine to create entirely new fruit combinations.

Start your journey with small and juicy fruits, combine them to create larger and more unique varieties. Your goal is to reach the magnificent watermelon that will be the culmination of your fruit adventure.

title: Monster Collect Run
description:
Triump over enemies & you will be able to play as them. Which critter do you think is the best?

Run through levels collecting crystals & mighty projectiles. Unleash your ammo unto many fantastic beasts, that dare to challenge you.

title: ASMR Nail Treatment
description: Today's patient is dealing with thickening of the fingernails. Help her maintain good nail hygiene by providing proper nail care. Showcase your medical skills by performing this ASMR Nail Treatment game. Once the treatment is done, dress her in fashionable outfit and create captivating nail art using various styles and accessories.

title: Bubble Escape
