Hone your attention to detail, enjoy the excitement of finding every difference, and experience hours of fun suitable for all ages!

title: CarJamcolor
description:
There was a long queue of passengers at the public station platform with a "car jam" in the parking lot! what to do?

Now it's time for the cars to transport passengers, you need to move them...but wait! You need to do it in the right order. Because other cars in the parking lot that become an obstacle! Can you solve this tricky parking puzzle and get all the cars on the road?
what are you waiting for? Challenge your brain with this tricky game now!

title: My Parking Lot
description: Welcome to "My Parking Lot," the ultimate puzzle challenge! Navigate through a chaotic mess of cars stuck in a parking lot and strategize to safely remove each vehicle without crashing them into each other. Your goal? Clear the parking lot by guiding all the cars to the exit, unlocking new levels as you master the art of precision parking. Can you untangle the traffic and solve each puzzle with finesse? Test your skills in "My Parking Lot" now!

title: Ellie Christmas Makeup
description: Experience the joy of festive makeovers with Ellie Christmas Makeup game! This fun, holiday game lets you guide Ellie to create three Christmas-themed makeup looks: Candy Cane Queen, Christmas Queen, and iconic character-inspired. Perfect for makeup lovers and enthusiasts of holiday-themed games alike, this girl game takes you on a journey filled with creativity, color, and Christmas cheer! Craft Ellie's look using assorted eyeshadows, lipsticks, patterned blushes, accessories, and more.

title: Tripeaks Solitaire Escapes
description: Play Solitaire TriPeaks Escapes, a relaxing card game with a warm summer vibe. Explore hundreds of unique solitaire levels featuring stunning graphics and vibrant beach landscapes. Master challenging card puzzles using powerful boosters, train your brain and sharpen your strategy. Dive into this colorful TriPeaks world and enjoy a soothing, slow-paced adventure. Escape the daily grind and find your zen in every hand you play!

title: Stickman Guys Defense
description:
Stickman Guys Defense is an action-packed tower defense game where you must protect your base from endless waves of enemies! Command a team of brave stickman warriors, place them strategically, and upgrade their abilities to stop the invasion. From archers to sword fighters, build the ultimate defense and survive each level!

Can you defend your land and become the ultimate Stickman commander?

title: Jump Dash
description:
Leap, soar, and survive in this fast-paced rhythm platformer!
Step into the intense world of Jump Dash, where every move must be perfectly timed. Test your reflexes as you jump, glide, and flip through treacherous levels packed with spikes, traps, and relentless obstacles.

title: Ice Cream Fever Cooking Game
description: In this frozen treat game, embark on a delightful journey through a world of creamy concoctions, toppings, and the most scrumptious sundaes you've ever dreamed of. If you're a fan of cooking games and have a soft spot for delectable desserts, "Ice Cream Fever" is the game you've been craving!

title: Winter Maze
description:
Step into a frosty puzzle adventure with Winter Maze! Explore icy, snow-covered mazes and guide your ball through slippery, twisty paths that fill up with every move. Each level challenges you to think ahead, plan your route and clear the entire field to unlock the next stage.
Simply swipe to roll the ball in any direction and watch the maze come to life beneath you. Your goal is clear: cover every tile and leave no space untouched.

title: Tricky Castle
description: The knight finds himself in a medieval castle full of tricky traps and puzzles. His goal is to escape by overcoming dangerous levels. Help the hero get out of this treacherous place and test your skills in our thrilling platformer!

title: Flappy Rush
description: flappy rush is a simple casual game. touch to fly, hold to hover and release to fall. in this game your agility will be tested, pass obstacles and don't crash to stay alive, enjoy the music and complete levels that challenge your adrenaline

title: Block Craft 3D School
description: Welcome to Block Craft 3D-School. Here creativity meets adventure! In this pixel-style game, you will enter a world of endless possibilities, like Minecraft. To build and protect your school using blocks of various shapes! But be careful that this isn't just a building game! Enemies hide anywhere and are ready to hit you! Besides, collect and place blocks.

title: Troll The Teacher
description:
Laugh and prank the teacher in this fun school game!

Have you ever dreamed of playing a prank on your teacher? Now you have a chance! In this game, you will become a student who arranges funny pranks right during the lesson. Use the most unexpected "tools", upgrade them and watch the funny reactions of the teacher!

title: Girl Rescue Dragon Out
description: In Girl Rescue: Dragon Out!, evil dragons and sneaky snakes are threatening a helpless girl. Only you can save her! This exciting rescue puzzle game blends shooting, colorful match mechanics, and epic boss battles into one exciting adventure! Click on the correct color cannon to destroy the corresponding color part of this flying dragon.

title: Air Block
description:
Jump, Place Blocks, and Conquer Challenging Levels!

In Air Block, use quick reflexes and smart block placement to overcome obstacles and enemies. With limited blocks per level, every move counts! Avoid saws, spikes, and unlock doors to progress—plus, grab those bananas if you can!

Game Modes:

Single Player – Test your skills across unique levels.
Two-Player Mode – Compete in quick place challenges and mini-games like Beach Ball, with more to come!
Think you’ve got what it takes? Start now!

title: Obby & Dead River
description: Dive into an exciting first-person 3D adventure in the style of Roblox! Your mission is to go through a dangerous path along the legendary river of death, connecting many large castles. Playing as a warrior, you will have to overcome thousands of kilometers, fight monsters and pirates, defeat dragons and get to the final boss.

title: Void Orbit
description: Void Orbit is an addictive space arcade game where you orbit a central core and dodge incoming enemies. Tap to reverse direction and survive as long as possible! Unlock cool skins, dynamic themes, enjoy challenging modes like Echo Mirage and Tower Build. Multi-language support for global players. Free to play, endless fun!

title: Slenderman Back to School
description: On a very mysterious night you wake up and find yourself trapped in your high school, a town in Massachusetts, and you will have to survive until dawn and escape from the urban legend Slenderman. In Slenderman Back to School, a 3D online game, you will be able to feel the adrenaline that a horror game feels like.

title: Good Sort Master: Triple Match
description:
A new game for those who like to put order on the shelf, in the closet, in the refrigerator. Collect identical items in groups of 3 - sort, arrange, tidy!
Connect items three in a row, create coziness! Cleaning has never been so interesting and fun!
A simple and relaxing game for women and men of all ages!

title: Gun Craft Run Weapon Fire
description: Gun Craft Run Weapon Fire is an adrenaline-pumping endless running game that combines the thrill of shooting with the excitement of parkour. You must swiftly collect bullets and ammo packs to keep your gun firing. The obstacles are everywhere, but with quick reflexes and precise aiming, you can dodge them all. With its fast-paced gameplay, stunning visuals, and addictive soundtrack, Gun Craft Run Weapon Fire will keep you on the edge of your seat for hours on end.

title: Chroma Tower
description: Chroma Tower is a reverse-Tetris puzzle where you destroy instead of build! You're given a tower made of colored blocks. Drop blocks from above, match the color — and the entire connected chain disappears. Blocks fall to fill the gaps, potentially triggering new cascade reactions. Your goal is to demolish the tower completely within a limited number of moves.

title: Candy Chain Master
description: Welcome to Candy Chain Master! The board has blue tiles with candies on them. Start by selecting a candy and move across nearby tiles with the same candy to make a chain of three or more. Each tile must turn golden by matching at least one candy on it. Think carefully and move fast to turn all tiles golden before time runs out.

title: Conquer.io
description: Expand your zone and assert your dominance over every territory on the map. Plan your moves to outmaneuver opponents and gain as much space as possible. But beware, your rivals will stop at nothing to thwart your plans. Are you ready to claim your space?

title: Crazy Zoo Swipe - Match 3 Puzzle Game
description: Welcome to the Crazy Zoo. Connect the same animals here to eliminate them. The more you connect, the greater the chance of obtaining powerful props. If you encounter a difficult level after that, use it wisely to let it burst out with unimaginable magic. Energy light waves, successfully pass the level!

title: Snow Rider Obby Parkour
description:
Snow Rider Obby Parkour is a fast-paced snowboard adventure where reflexes, timing, and control matter. Play solo or with a friend in split-screen mode and experience different snow challenges across multiple game modes. Whether you want to beat distance records, explore a massive open world, or race down dangerous mountains, this game offers a complete snowboarding experience.

Master your snowboard, perform double jumps, and unlock amazing gear to customize your character!

title: HexaMatch
description:
HexaMatch – The Ultimate Number Puzzle!
Swipe and sort tiles into the empty slot to solve addictive hexa puzzles. With progressive difficulty, unique gameplay, and a fresh twist on classic number games, HexaMatch is perfect for all ages. Train your brain, relax your mind, and enjoy endless fun with this simple yet challenging merge hexa puzzle!

title: CS: Command Snipers
description: "CS: Command Snipers" is an exciting online game where players take on the role of elite snipers who carry out challenging missions in various combat environments. The game combines elements of tactics, precision and teamwork, providing a unique experience for fans of shooters and strategies.

title: Unicycle Balance 3D
description:
Balance, Pedal & Survive.

Enter the wacky and challenging world of Unicycle Balance 3D, a physics-based balancing game that tests your skill, patience, and reflexes! Guide your unicyclist across surreal landscapes, avoiding obstacles and mastering the delicate art of staying upright.

title: Food Merge
description: ​Food Merge is a game where you combine different foods to create delicious dishes and serve them to hungry customers. Merge ingredients quickly and strategically to before the time runs out! Each level brings new challenges, faster orders, and more complex combos. Can you keep up and become the ultimate food master?

title: Bus Stop Color Jam
description: A great passenger color sorting game begins with the Bus Stop Color Jam game! Sort the passengers by their color and get them into the buses. Once the buses are full, they will move to the destination point. Use power-ups when you need them. Over 400+ game levels are waiting for you! An entertaining Bus Stop Jam is beginning!

title: Magic Sort
description:
Welcome to Magic Sort! — a relaxing and satisfying color-sorting puzzle with a cute cat café twist!
Your job is to organize colorful water layers inside multiple bottles. Each bottle contains mixed colors, and you must pour them carefully to sort every color correctly. Remember:
You can only pour when the top layers are the same color.
Once a bottle is perfectly sorted and filled with a single color, it magically transforms into a finished drink for your adorable cat customers!

title: Coe Rabbit
description:
Coe Rabbit is a puzzle platformer where you control a cute bunny and teleport him between platforms! Progress through each level by teleporting to higher platforms, collecting power-ups to adjust the height of your portal, and find the perfect path to reach your destination!

Also have fun with the floating bunny, where you control a carrot ship and avoid crashing into obstacles. Play with your best friend in the challenging two-player mode. Who will win?

title: Bloxorz - Block Puzzle 3d
description: Roll your block across challenging 3D platforms and drop it into the goal hole to solve each puzzle. Bloxorz - Block Puzzle 3d is an addictive block puzzle game that tests your logic, spatial thinking, and problem-solving skills across dozens of mind-bending levels.

title: Triple Sort 3D Home Design
description: Welcome to the world of Triple Sort 3D: Home Design, where matching meets decorating! Dive in the puzzle-solving with and begin crafting a virtual space of your dreams. Get ready to transform ugly and cluttered rooms  into clean and cozy spaces! Discover the perfect blend of challenges, creativity, and an epic makeover journey that awaits you!

title: Hill Climb Truck Transform Adventure
description: Hill Climb: Truck Transform Adventure is actually a 2D balance stunt adventure game. You have 3 kinds of vehicles to transform and overpass different terrains. While keeping the vehicle balanced, you can climb different ramps and terrains. If you crash obstacles or terrains, you can collect repair plates to recover. If you want to overpass the next harder levels, you can upgrade your vehicles with 4 acceleration abilities.

title: V And N Pizza Cooking Game
description: Experience the ultimate virtual pizza-making adventure with the V And N Pizza Cooking Game! Craft delicious pizzas from scratch, choose mouthwatering toppings, and master the art of baking. From classic favorites to innovative creations, unleash your inner chef and create culinary masterpieces.

title: Pixel Art
description: With pixel art, paint cubes with the right colors and create pixel art. the right colors and cubes are waiting for you to paint

title: Soccer Dash
description:
Soccer dash is a soccer game in which you swipe a soccer ball through obstacles and soccer players and hit the ball to score a goal.

You have drag controls, drag to choose the direction of the kick, and release to hit the ball. During the dragging process, the game goes into a slow motion state, so you can take your time to choose the direction of the kick.

title: Woop Crawl Up
description: Woop Tower Climb is a fun arcade climbing challenge where you crawl, jump, and dash your way up endless towers. Dodge tricky traps, survive obstacle course chaos, and master platformer moves to reach the top. Perfect for fans of climbing games, jump games, obstacle course adventures, and even cool math games students search for online. Addictive, casual, and funny—how high can you Woop Crawl Up?

title: Jenny's Math Puzzle
description: Challenge your mind with Jenny’s Math Puzzle, a fun and brain-boosting online game where logic meets creativity. Arrange number tiles to solve equations, unlock new puzzles, and sharpen your math skills along the way. Play on your phone or computer — every move counts, and every solution brings you closer to becoming a true math master.

title: Garden Guardians
description:
A fun and strategic tower defense game that’s easy to pick up!
Tap directional arrows to launch seeds into flowerpots—each seed blossoms into a powerful flower ready to blast incoming zombies. Plan your moves, hold the line, and protect your garden from the undead horde!

title: Paper.io 2
description:
Conquer as much territory as possible and beat the competition.
A smooth drawing experience!

Use your paper block to steal the area from your online opponents in this game. Capture as much space as possible and try to get the highest score in the lobby. If you move outside your own color, your tail becomes exposed. You will be eliminated when someone manages to catch your tail. So you need to take risks to expand your colored area.

title: Woods of Nevia: Forest Survival
description: Woods of Nevia: Forest Survival is a one-tap action adventure where you battle and survive in the wild. Wield your axe to fend off wolves, chop wood, and build shelter as you explore for resources and hidden chests. Level up, choose upgrades, and outlast growing dangers while managing hunger and health in this engaging forest challenge.

title: Ball Jump Switch The Colors
description:
Tap on the screen, that will make the ball bounce higher and higher. The ball has one color, and can pass through obstacle with the same color, or sneak in between obstacles with different colors.

Easy-to-play and addictive !

title: Backflip Master
description: Backflip Master is the most popular in sports' game. The main test of the player's mastery of backflips and skills. You need to backflip to reach the finished line. Of course, there will be some obstacles on the way, you must also flip over. So, are you ready to challenge this game now? Come on!

title: Uno Online
description:
UNO Online is a strategy card game. In the game, the first player to clear his hand will become the winner. In order to win, you need to guess the deck of cards in your opponent's hands and  arrange your card order reasonably. There are also function cards in the game. When you draw a function card, think about how to turn the situation to your advantage. You can use color cards to
change the color of the game, or use +2 cards to make your opponent's cards never run out.

title: Color Nuts
description:
Color Nuts is a relaxing and addictive color-matching puzzle game where you place colorful nuts on the board and connect three or more of the same color to clear them.

Plan your moves carefully, complete level objectives, and keep the board from filling up. Easy to learn and hard to master, Color Nuts is the perfect casual puzzle game for fans of match-3, block puzzles, and logic games.

title: Street Traffic Racer
description: Skid the wheels of 6 stunning street cars with modified body kits and drive them through 3 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself in Street Traffic Racer

title: Runic Block Collapse
description: Welcome to 'Runic Block Collapse'! Tap any block to clear connected blocks in a chain reaction. Removing one block costs 250 points. Removing 2 or more blocks earns points, with larger groups earning more per block. Reach the target score to advance. If you fail, start over. Enjoy endless fun!

title: Last Stand Warrior
description:
A thrilling third-person shooter where you play as an experienced shooter defending your land from endless hordes of enemies. Control the hero, apply precise punches, use skills and fight with waves of mobs to prevent them from breaking through. Upgrade your weapons and abilities to become a true defense champion!

Ideal for fans of dynamic gameplay, arcade battles and survival in the «wave of opponents» mode.

title: Color Dots Challenge
description: Dive into Color Dots Challenge, a bright and addictive puzzle game that puts your logic and strategy to the test. Connect, match, and move colorful dots to clear the board and score big! Simple to play yet hard to master, this free online game is perfect for quick breaks or long sessions on your phone or computer. Can you outsmart the colors and conquer every level?

title: Obby - Escape Barry's jail parkour
description: An incredible escape from the New Barry Prison awaits you! Cool locations, parkour and obby. Show your agility to avoid getting caught by Barry.

title: Tricky Arrow 2
description: Get ready to sharpen your skills in Tricky Arrow 2! Sequence of Tricky Arrow. Test your precision and reflexes as you shoot arrows at a spinning circle target. Aim for the bullseye and avoid hitting other arrows. With each twist and spin, the challenge grows, requiring strategy and accuracy. Simple yet addictive gameplay for all ages.

title: Stick Man Battle Fighting
description: Enter the world of Stick Man Battle Fighting and every move matters! This casual fighting game lets you unleash your skills in dynamic stickman battles against enemies. Master various fighting styles and begin exciting single-mode combat. Choose a weapon and customize your hero.

title: Ball Sort
description: Ball Sort is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you sort colorful balls into tubes – can you solve the puzzle with fewer moves?

title: Color Water Puzzle
description:
Color Water Puzzle is a fun and addictive puzzle game! The goal is simple yet challenging: try to sort the colored water in the glasses until all colors are in the same glass.

It’s not just a game; it's a great way to relieve stress and exercise your logic. With vibrant colors and smooth pouring effects, this is the best choice to kill time and relax your mind.

Are you smart enough to solve all the levels? Download now and find out!

title: Ultimate Tower Defense
description: Ultimate Tower Defense is an exciting strategy game that perfectly blends tower defense, battle, and fast-paced action into one addictive experience. In the game, you must carefully protect defense towers and deploy powerful heroes to stop endless waves of enemies. Each tower has unique attack abilities. Select your preferred mode to begin the challenge.

title: Stickman Santa
description: In Stickman Santa, Santa’s holiday mission hits a snag when a mischievous stickman makes off with all the presents! Help Santa choose the perfect way to teach the stickman a lesson and reclaim the stolen gifts.

title: Delta Force Airborne
description:
This game offers a whole new level of graphics and sound design that completely immerses you in a realistic atmosphere of battles. 
Shoot and use tactical thinking to overcome obstacles and achieve victory together with your team. 
Explore a variety of maps, each of which is full of unique opportunities and strategic points.
Become a master of team play by coordinating with your teammates and using different character classes to create the perfect strategy.

title: Match Collection
description: Collect 3 of the same items from the shelf to erase them. When a shelf is empty, the shelf above it falls down. You can have up to 7 items, and when your hand is full, the game is over. When all items are erased, the stage is cleared.

title: Grukkle Onslaught
description: Grukkle Onslaught: Defend the blue portal in this thrilling tower defense game! Strategically place towers to fend off waves of enemies and protect your gateway. Master strategy and quick thinking to emerge victorious. Play now and prove your skills!

title: Flip It 3D
description: In this fun and challenging puzzle platform game, test your strategic thinking as you navigate through levels where flipping platforms is the key to survival! Goblins and knights have different abilities, and they must be moved carefully across platforms to complete each level. But be careful—characters can only survive a limited number of flips, and platforms can't be flipped if they are occupied!

title: Sweet And Fruity Makeup
description: From luscious watermelon pinks to zesty lemon yellows and tangy orange hues, this game allows you to experiment with a selection of deliciously scented cosmetics. Create stunning looks using fruity lip glosses, shimmering eyeshadows, and blushes that mimic the radiant glow of ripe berries. Let your imagination run wild as you mix and match fruity fragrances, adding a delightful touch of freshness to your final touch. So, get ready to enter a delectable paradise where sweetness meets style!

title: Chroma Trek
description:
Dive into the glowing world of Chroma Trek, a vibrant neon platformer where every step is a test of skill and perception. With dazzling visuals and a unique color-switching mechanic, each level feels like a handcrafted puzzle filled with dynamic challenges.

Shift colors to phase through obstacles, stay sharp to dodge traps, and be inspired by motivational messages that guide you along the way. Your goal? Reach the shimmering Finish Crystal and conquer every stage with style.

title: Mission Santa: Deliver the Gifts
description:
Santa must deliver gifts to children in time! There are many kids and only one Santa, so everything has to be done on the fly! Fly in a sleigh on Christmas night and throw gifts down chimneys to make children happy. 

The game helps you feel the atmosphere of the approaching holiday and prepare for the most magical time of the year!

title: Mini Games Relax Collection 2
description: Relax and take a mini-game tour! Mini Games: Relax Collection 2 brings you a series of casual and fun mini-games, designed for you to relax in your spare time! There are various types of games,each easy to play and extremely fun, allowing you to immerse yourself easily in the game world.

title: Hoard Master Online
description: This is an upgrade and construction simulation game in which Empty is the protagonist. Use it to devour everything you want in exchange for money. Build and upgrade your black holes and territories!

title: The Trendy Mermaid
description: Embark on an exciting journey of makeup, accessories, and fashion to help Ariel make an unforgettable comeback. With a wide selection of clothes, makeup, and accessories, help Ariel become the trendiest mermaid ever. Enjoy making her look dreamy and fabulous - The Trendy Mermaid is free to play for every girl.

title: ASMR Makeover & Makeup Studio
description: Get ready to dive into the world of beauty and creativity! ASMR Makeup & Makeover Studio offers an incredible opportunity to give your virtual model a stunning makeover. This isn't just any makeover game — it's an immersive experience that combines relaxation and excitement through the power of ASMR!

title: Wacky Wheels
description:
? Wacky Wheels – Drift, Dodge & Dominate!
Master the chaos in Wacky Wheels, the ultimate test of timing and control!
Navigate wild tracks, drift through tight turns, dodge massive hammers, and collect stars — all before the clock runs out. Each level brings new challenges, themes, and physics that’ll keep you on the edge of your seat.

? It’s not just a race — it’s a wacky adventure of skill and speed!

title: Hero Wizard: Save Your Girlfriend
description: One day when I woke up, I saw that my girlfriend wasn't beside me, so I started searching around for her but couldn't find her. Then I noticed a letter on the table, and the letter said: "If you want to see your girlfriend again, you'll have to pass through the magic forest to rescue her, but it won't be easy because you're not alone in the forest!" At first, I didn't understand, but..

title: Brainrot Memory
description:
Memory Brainrot: Boost Your Brain with Meme Power!

Flip cards, match pairs, and meet iconic characters from the Italian Brainrot meme universe! Play in a vibrant cartoon world, train your memory, and unlock chaotic fun. With two difficulty levels and dozens of legendary meme heroes to discover, this game is both brain-boosting and hilarious. Dive into pure meme madness and rot your brain... but in the best way! ??

title: Spaceflight Simulator
description: Do you have a space dream? Spaceflight Simulator is a challenging spaceflight simulation game suitable for boys who love to build and launch rockets. The game has real-life conditions in space.

title: Fruitsland: Escape from the Amusement Park
description: Fruitsland: Escape from the Amusement Park is a horror escape adventure where bright amusement park rides hide lurking dangers. Players must solve puzzles, collect items, and uncover clues while evading hostile enemies. Stealth and timing are crucial—explore cautiously, hide when needed, and outsmart the threats to survive and escape. The mix of colorful setting and eerie tension creates a unique, suspenseful experience.

title: Zip Zap
description: Step into the fascinating world of Zip Zap, a unique online physics puzzle game that blends mechanics, movement, and precision. Tap, twist, and control your way through clever levels filled with moving parts and intricate structures. Every stage tests your timing and creativity — can you reach every target? Play for free on desktop or mobile and enjoy a perfectly balanced mix of challenge and relaxation.

title: Merge Tower Hero
description: Dive into Merge Tower Hero, an exhilarating online puzzle - Merge game that sharpens your mathematical thinking while exhilaratingly combining action, strategy, and combat. Assemble your team and tackle challenging battles that require not only strength but clever gameplay strategies to prevail!

description:
This is a puzzle game. you can make a way to pass a level. Dig your way through unique physics puzzles.

It's new and fun brain teasers each step of the way.

title: Wood Block Puzzle 3

Drag shapes from the right tray, complete rows or columns to score, and chase your best record. Use boosters at the bottom—watch rewarded ads to earn coins and unlock boosters when needed. Simple to learn and hard to master, it’s perfect for quick breaks or long zen sessions.

title: Merge Muscle
description: Create the most powerful gym, connect athletes!  A large gym is at your disposal. Your task is to get new athletes, combine similar ones to get more powerful athletes. The most powerful athletes can be taken to a boxing competition. You need to click as often and quickly as possible to defeat your opponent in a difficult battle.

title: Army Fight 3d
description: Begin the nervous army battles in Army Fight 3D. Here you need strategic thinking and quick reflexes.In this fun action battle game, you aim to build a powerful army. Defend your base, and defeat the enemy. Start by creating and upgrading your army.

title: Car Dealer Idle
description: Ever dreamed of becoming a top Car Dealer? In Car Dealer Idle, you’ll manage your own vehicle business. Buy and sell cars, expand your showroom, and grow into a real tycoon. Make smart management decisions, upgrade your dealership, and watch your profits skyrocket. Unlock more booths to sell cooler vehicles. Unlock repair areas, test drive areas, etc.

title: Boxteria
description:
Dive into an amazing cubic world, where you can become anyone from a BANDIT to a ZOMBIE attacking everyone around! Imagine having 20 super cool cars at your disposal to ride, drift, and have fun on maps like "Russian Village," and "Courtyard," spaces filled with adventures.

You'll enjoy creating characters, each unique in their own way. You can assemble a team of bandits, zombies, or even police officers and engage in thrilling battles or cool races.

title: Sausage Flip Free
description: In Sausage Flip Free, you're not just any sausage. You’re a daring, bouncy hero on a mission to overcome wild levels full of danger, timing, and precision! This action, casual game blends goofy fun with real skill challenges! Tap to launch your sausage with a perfect flip! Launch the sausage on the vine and keep moving to the next pot or shelf, etc. Use your perfect skills to master each tricky obstacle. Cross the finish line to win.

title: Lava Jump
description: Lava Jump is a fast-paced parkour platformer set in a deadly lava-filled dungeon! Jump across moving blocks, bounce off boost pads, and ride shifting platforms to survive. Complete more than 25 levels, evade enemies, spikes and other deadly objects and escape from the lava dungeon alive. Collect coins and get new characters to use in your adventure.

title: Sort Puzzle - Nuts and Bolts
description: Play Sort Puzzle - Nuts and Bolts, a free and addictive sorting game! Train your brain by stacking nuts of the same color. Simple yet challenging, it's the perfect casual game to relax and sharpen your logic skills. Play now and start sorting!

title: Max Mixed Cocktails
description: Do you want to become a master mixologist? Create cocktails by blending ingredients at the bar. Choose your ingredients, mix them skillfully, and sample the concoction. You'll reach a delightful conclusion by discovering the perfect recipe. Utilize clues in the collections to unlock different endings.

title: Fashion World Simulator
description: It's time for some super cool styles! Be a fabulous fashionista stylist and dress up a supermodel to rule all the fashion runways around the world! Get ready to dive into the ultimate dress-up experience and show your creativity. This game is all about makeovers, dress-ups, and decorating new cool stuff. Compete and vote for your style to win the competition. Join us and start your fashion journey!

title: Road Of Fury 4
description: Road Of Fury 4 is a scroller shooter game set in a world of post-apocalypse. Team-up with other nomads, upgrade cars, guns and super-powers and use your skills to fight through 30 levels and 3 bosses.

title: Vikings: An Archer's Journey
description: Vikings: An Archer’s Journey blends the fast-paced action of a shoot ’em up with the adrenaline rush of an infinite runner, all presented in a striking minimalist art style. Play as Nott, a fearless Valkyrie archer, on a quest to save her wolf, Oder, from the Underworld. Use intuitive controls, collect powerful upgrades, and team up with Viking heroes to face off against mythical Nordic creatures in this thrilling adventure.

title: Paint Master
description: Fill the squares to match the sample pattern. Tap the brush to paint a straight line of squares in one move. When your moves reach zero the game is over, so use them carefully to clear the stage!

title: Cat Cut
description: A fun game about a hungry cat, get him a fish, cut the rope so that it falls directly to the cat. All objects move according to physics, do not miss the fish, do not upset the cat!

title: Geometry Arrow 2
description: Geometry Arrow 2 is the fast-paced sequel to the original rhythm arcade hit! Navigate through 6 dynamic levels, dodging obstacles that move to the beat. Switch between the Arrow and the all-new Wheel character, each with unique mechanics. Unlock achievements and customize your Arrow and Wheel with different skins, particles, and block textures. Time your moves, feel the rhythm, and reach the portal in perfect sync!

title: Capybara Xmas Merge
description:
Capybara Xmas Merge is a cute and cozy holiday game where you combine adorable Christmas capybaras!
Drop festive capybaras into the box, watch them roll and bump into each other, and merge into bigger, funnier holiday characters.
Create giant capybaras, score points, and enjoy the warm winter atmosphere.

title: Mr Long Legs
description: Get ready to wobble, stretch, and stumble with Mr. Long Legs, the funniest physics puzzle game you’ll ever play! Step into the shoes of a long-legged stickman hero and control his stretchy legs to cross impossible terrains.

title: Merge Galaxy
description:
The famous merge game is arrived!
You can shoot the planets like balls to throw, and when the same planets touch each other, it becomes bigger planet!
Cute planets want to be bigger, so keep merge the planets until you make the sun!

title: My Cottagecore Aesthetic Look
description: Welcome to the My Cottagecore Aesthetic Look game. Cottagecore fashion is inspired by farm life, it is very impractical for doing chores around the farm! Princess Elsa, Anna, and Ariel are best friends planning to try something special. Get ready to explore the Cottagecore fashion style along with them to create the cutest looks!

title: Overflowing Palette
description:
Test your puzzle-solving skills in Overflowing Palette! Pick the perfect colors, flood the board, and fill every tile before your moves run out. You'll find plenty of levels with different mechanics, an endless mode without a move counter if you want to relax, and the ability to create and share your own levels.

Credits
Based on the puzzle of the same name from the game "Wuthering Waves " by Kuro Games.

title: Miner's Fury!
description:
Miner's Fury! Avoid and destroy!

Clear and destroy rock waves. Lookout for mystery rocks too! Buy and deploy Turrets to breeze through levels. 
Collect the coins that drop from the destroyed rocks, and spend them buying Turrets, and to Upgrade yourself. Upgrades will make you deal more damage faster, earn more coins, as well as improving your spawned Turrets.
Lookout for Missions to earn rewards!

Made with ❤️ by Realinspirer

title: Fish Shooting Fish Hunter
description: Want to begin a fun and relaxing fishing adventure? In Fish Shooting - Fish Hunter, you’ll become a fishing master. Use your skills and quick reflexes to catch various fish while enjoying a laid-back casual experience!

title: Fire Truck Driving Simulator
description: Fire Truck Driving Simulator is a fire truck driving simulation game with 4 different modes. In Level Mode, you need to arrive at the fire area and put it out in time in 10 levels. In City Mode, you have a chance to decide to accept the emergency missions on the street freely. In Free Mode, you can train your fireman knowledge without any limitations. In Parking Mode, you can forget about fire-rescue missions and train your parking skills. Enjoy your fireman time!

title: Girlfriend from Hell
description:
Girlfriend From Hell is an addictive and fun 2D arcade puzzle game. The main goal of the game is the girl's revenge on her lover. The heroine needs to find objects and use them to make her boyfriend's life hell.  
You need to collect various items to make a trap with them.

title: Among Squid Challenge Online
description: All players, get ready. They are hiding in a maze. To win the game, you must defeat all the other players. You have a knife and must defeat everyone. Catch the players one by one and make sure they are eliminated. Don’t worry, they won’t find you. If they try to find you, hide in the ventilation holes. Defeat all the players. Be careful, and whatever you do, don't reveal yourself. If they catch you, you will lose and they will defeat you.

title: Bed Wars
description:
Take on the role of a commander, control your squad of stickmen, upgrade your soldiers, upgrade your base defense, get resources, fight on the battlefield with other players and capture enemy bases. And the enemy bases are their beds.
The game has many levels. With each level, the base becomes more and more difficult to defend, and opponents become more aggressive and powerful. Will you be able to maintain your position as a Leader and defeat everyone?

title: Bird Sort Challenges
description:
Bird Sort Challenges  is a fun and relaxing game where you sort colorful birds perched on branches, arranging them by matching colors.
Test your problem-solving skills as you strategize to ensure no branch overflows and complete each puzzle efficiently.
Whether you’re looking to unwind or sharpen your mind, Bird Sort: Color Sort Puzzle offers endless entertainment in a cheerful and visually pleasing world.
Good luck!

title: Obby Pinata Party
description: Help the Obby guy to fight those pinatas and Explore the world. Choose from wide variety of weapons, collect coins and upgrade them. Make the pinatas give you every penny they have!

title: Real Car Parking And Stunt
description: Welcome to Real Car Parking And Stunt, a challenging driving simulation game. Here you’ll control a car and put your parking and stunt skills to the test. Choose stunt mode or parking mode, each level challenges you to park your car accurately while performing exciting stunts.

title: Spinning Uia Uia Cat Bricker
description: Spinning Uia Uia Cat Bricker is a fun and addictive brick-breaking game where a lively cat motivates you with cheerful meows. Your goal is to clear all the bricks without dropping the ball. As you break more bricks, the cat gets even more excited, dancing and playing around. With colorful graphics and dynamic gameplay, this game offers a delightful experience for players of all ages. Stay sharp and keep up!

title: People Playground: Ragdoll Battle
description:
Welcome to People Playground: Ragdoll Battle!
Carefully control your character to strike the right spots on your opponent’s body. Attack strategically to destroy and crush your enemies. Earn gold coins to unlock new characters and upgrade your skills.
Have fun and dominate the arena!

title: Balls Vs Lasers
description: Begin a wonderful arcade challenge. In Balls Vs Lasers, your skill and reaction speed will be limited. Control two balls and avoid incoming lasers. Flexible avoiding and challenging your extreme operation. Control the movement of the two balls and avoid the oncoming laser attacks! Place balls of the same color against the corresponding laser.

title: Ramp Bike Jumping
description: Perform the most unimaginable stunts on motorcycles, bicycles, even skis! There’s no backbone to be broken here! And we know a guy who knows a guy, whose sister-in-law bent some laws of physics for us. That’s right, you can get really crazy with our game. So buckle up, or not... It doesn’t matter. The only thing that matters is pure fun and madness!! YEE-HAW!

title: 2248 Block Merge
description: Upon beginning to play, you will undoubtedly become hooked on these 2048 puzzle games. They are crafted with stunning visuals and user-friendly gameplay, making them an excellent option for enthusiasts of number block puzzle games.

title: Winter CosmoFest
description: Immerse yourself in a magical winter adventure in the Honkai universe. Show your creativity by creating festive cosplay outfits for the heroes of the game. Combine gorgeous costumes, accessories and hairstyles to capture the spirit of your favorite characters among snowflakes and winter landscapes. Show off your fashion skills by choosing the perfect ensemble for the winter cosplay festival. Win the hearts of Honkai fans and share your ideas with your friends!

title: TB Avataria Life Girl
description:
Hey, how about helping me decorate my house? You need to decorate my home beautifully, buy me nice clothes, and feed me. Let's get started — right now, I have an empty house, and we need to furnish it together. Let's make it look organized and cozy! Before I get too hungry, you must take me to the café to eat, or I might lose my life from hunger!
We also need to earn money. To make money, reach the computer and use the money-making app. You can either buy things or continue earning more money!

title: Sprunki Space Challenge
description: Get ready to soar through the stars in Sprunki Space Challenge an intergalactic online adventure where brave kids take flight to save the galaxy. This wild space ride throws you into the cockpit of a zippy space rover where danger lurks in every asteroid and rocket burst. But worry not: Sprunki is here to lead the charge. It is all about timing, reflexes, and sky-high jumps that send you sailing straight into the action.

title: Combinations Daily
description: Connect the tiles, make combinations and experience the ultimate puzzle adventure. Come back everyday for new challenges and maintain your monthly streaks!

title: Frog Knight
description: Frog Bubble your mission is to help a spirited frog pop an array of mischievous bubbles! Using your swift reflexes and strategic skills, you’ll throw your lily pad-shaped projectiles at bubbles to clear each level.

title: About a Frog
description: Jump into the world of About a Frog, a fun and free online game where you play as a brave little frog. Explore colorful levels, dodge obstacles, and enjoy the adventure on your phone or computer. It’s a light and exciting challenge for players who love quick reflexes and cute characters.

title: Pyramidz2
description: PyramidZ 2 is, as the name suggests, the sequel to PyramidZ. It's a Match-3 game where you have to slide a row or column to align Egyptian symbols. This version is faster and allows for more combos.

title: 3D Basketball.io Dunk Sport
description: Sports Basketball is a thrilling 3D basketball game that will keep you entertained for hours. Whether you're a basketball fan or just love fast-paced Sports games Fun

title: Real Driving Simulator
description: Real Driving Simulator is a realistic driving simulation game that lets you fully enjoy the thrill of driving and racing! In this game, you can unblock various vehicles and drive them through cities and tracks. Experience the real feel of being behind the wheel.

title: Capybara Block Drop
description:
Capybara Block Drop is a fast-paced, brain-teasing puzzle game where merging numbers and staying calm under pressure is the key to survival.

Drop numbered blocks into columns, combine matching tiles, and clear space with big combos.
But watch out, if the board fills up, it’s game over, and your capybara buddy might just lose his cool!

With colorful visuals and satisfying number-merging mechanics, Capybara Block Drop delivers endless strategic fun wrapped in a charming, lighthearted package.

title: Sword Life
description: The job of a blacksmith this one is not only how to forge the best sword! You have to get the most amazing materials, and then you have to sell the sword! But you can do it!

title: Bffs Spring Break Fashionista
description: Welcome to the Bffs Spring Break Fashionista. Spring break is here. Barbie and their friends are can’t wait to have some fun together. They’ve been waiting for the spring break since the beginning of the year. Help them prepare their spring break outfits! They can finally wear skirts and dresses since it’s really warm outside now, so make sure to create a cute look! Have fun!

title: Math Runner
description: Challenge your mind and reflexes in this fast-paced arithmetic adventure! Solve math problems on the run, dodge obstacles, and race against time to achieve the highest score. Perfect for players of all ages looking to sharpen their math skills while enjoying thrilling gameplay.

title: Sort Tiles
description:
Sort Tiles: Tap Away is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you move tiles, clear the board, and reveal hidden pictures. It’s simple to learn but offers endless logic challenges that keep your brain active. Perfect for fans of tile puzzles, logic games, and relaxing brain teasers.

Key Features:
Unique puzzle mechanics — move tiles in the arrow’s direction and solve logic puzzles step by step.
Hidden images — every cleared puzzle board reveals a new picture.

title: Office Brawl - Room Smash
description:
Become the hero of an office rebellion and destroy everything in your path! The player will have to transform into a disgruntled employee who challenges the system, destroys obstacles and fights the boss.

Use brute force and ingenuity to get through difficult tests, participate in intense battles and explosive actions.
Become an antihero and sow chaos from start to finish!

title: Zoo Anomaly Simulation
description: Experience a zoo mutation crisis like no other. In Zoo Anomaly Simulation, a peaceful zoo has turned into a nightmare filled with mutated animals, and you’re the only one who can stop the chaos! Enter a first-person shooting experience like no other. Explore the eerie zoo environment, grab your weapons, and fight back against giraffes, zebras, elephants, etc.

title: Screamals
description:
Change the shape of the characters with simple up-and-down manipulations
Even if obstacles get in the way, they can change their shape and pass through.
Break through the obstacle, collect the notes and fire them at the boss!

title: Craft of Wars
description: The war between the Reds and the Blues has never been more epic than in Craft of Wars! In this cubic game, you'll fight for strategic points on the map using a classic combat system similar to the one found in older versions of Minecraft. Prepare for intense sword and bow duels, TNT explosions, tactical use of potions, and the legendary golden apples that will help you survive the fiercest battles.

title: Stunt Car Extreme 2
description: Experience the exhilarating thrill of Stunt automobile Extreme 2, a remarkable 3D game that offers free access. Engage in extreme automobile driving on very challenging courses, which include moving platforms suspended in the sky. Navigate over intense obstacles and sharp bends to test your skills to the limit.

title: Nubik Courier An Open World
description: Become a top pizza delivery expert! Race through city streets, dodge obstacles, and switch between vehicles to deliver pizzas on time. Earn money, upgrade your gear, and master exciting challenges. Fast-paced, fun, and addictive—start delivering now!

title: Farm Defense
description: Farm Defense is a fast, arcade-style shooter where you guard your ranch from waves of quirky mutants. Move between lanes, aim, and blast anything that crawls out of the burrows before it reaches your crops. Earn coins, unlock new weapons and gadgets, and power up your electric fence. Bright visuals, snappy controls, and escalating waves make every run tense and satisfying.

title: Eye Art Perfect Makeup Artist
description: Eye Art Perfect Makeup Artist is a very sophisticated makeup game. This game has an eye makeup  theme that is very targeted. This game has 26 levels, which means there are 26 types of eye makeup  for you to choose from. No matter what style of makeup you prefer, you can find one that satisfies  you in this game. Want to know more about this game?

title: WorldCraft 3
description: Are you ready to survive in pixel world ? This is a challenge game survive in the pixel worlds, You have to prepare for every situations. You can fly and with your grenade you explode blocks world. You can collect items to your inventory

title: Italian Brainrot Baby Clicker
description: Get ready for the cutest twist on the viral Brainrot universe! Italian Brainrot Baby Clicker is the baby-themed sequel to the hit Brainrot Clicker! Tap your way through the baby versions of your favorite characters, collect upgrades, and enjoy a whole new atmosphere with colorful visuals, cheerful music, and fresh sound effects designed to fit the playful baby theme!

title: Pet Tile Master
description: Enjoy a fun pet-themed tile-matching challenge in Pet Tile Master! Draw up to 9 tiles featuring adorable pets and match three identical ones to clear them. Be careful—if the stack fills up with 9 tiles, the game is over! Use smart moves to uncover hidden tiles and complete each level. Have fun with cute animals, relaxing gameplay, and tricky puzzles!

title: Homo Evolution
description: Create your own world and guide human evolution! Merge creatures, unlock eight evolution stages, and shape civilization from tiny spores to modern life. Explore new planets, experiment with unique paths, and enjoy endless fun in this captivating evolution game. Play now!
